rights: Original text only; no client media

external_costs.status: Unresolved; this sample cannot be signed or booked

acceptance_tests: Six-field synthetic inquiry and failure states
included_revisions: One consolidated design round and one consolidated staging round; named approver within approved direction.
defect_window: 30 calendar days after launch for defects against accepted scope; does not consume revision rounds.
exclusions: No CMS, ecommerce, booking, member area, CRM/API integration or third-party subscription included.
Original research, legal drafting, extensive migration and unapproved extra scope.
change_process: Record deliverable, acceptance, fee/payment and date effect; obtain written approval before extra work.
paid_work_rights: Paid bespoke work/source and operating rights at relevant paid milestone or reconciled termination; disclosed third-party/preexisting licenses apply; accounts remain client-controlled.
cancellation_reconciliation: Dated completed-work/approved-committed-cost/payment ledger under signed terms; deposits not automatically earned. Existing paid materials and operating inventory within five business days; routine handoff included, new migration separate.
secret_policy: References only; never credentials or personal inquiry contents.

commercial_boundaries.page_scope: One primary service or tightly related service group and one primary market. Separate service, area, case-study, blog or landing pages are quoted additions when distinct intent and evidence justify them. Plain client-approved policy text may be linked; legal drafting excluded.
commercial_boundaries.included_pages: Up to three unique marketing pages chosen from the client's goals and search intent, not a mandatory Home/Services/Contact template. A proposal identifies exact canonical pages and which topics are consolidated.
commercial_boundaries.copy: Client provides facts, service details and approved imagery; one discovery interview; write/edit up to 1,200 words of new client-facing copy across included pages, including headlines, core sections and calls to action, plus metadata. The word ceiling is a scope change trigger, not a content target. One client fact-check and consolidated edits. No field research, photo shoot or long-form article.
commercial_boundaries.creative: Distinct art direction through typography, composition, color, imagery treatment and restrained code-native interaction using existing production patterns. No bespoke Blender/Remotion media or newly designed interactive system; optional still imagery requires client license or source.
commercial_boundaries.functionality: Mobile-first custom coded responsive site, one inquiry form through a client-controlled provider, basic spam defense, accessible navigation and tested contact path. No CMS, ecommerce, booking, member area, CRM/API integration or third-party subscription included.
commercial_boundaries.seo_foundation: Agreed keyword-to-canonical-page map, semantic structure, titles/meta, index/canonical/sitemap and redirect checks, structured data only for verified facts, Search Console/analytics setup or connection with access, and launch validation. No ongoing SEO program or ranking guarantee.
commercial_boundaries.platform_fit: Custom static website; no self-service visual editor. Choose a technical editor, separately quoted changes or eligible Care. Frequent publishing, a CMS or a different platform must be scoped before deposit.
commercial_boundaries.policy: One plain /privacy/ page containing client-approved supplied text is included beyond the marketing-page cap; no legal drafting. Other policies separately agreed.
commercial_boundaries.form: One form, up to six fields, one receiving destination, one confirmation state; no CRM/API workflow, uploads, payments or sensitive-data intake.
commercial_boundaries.redirects: Up to 10 simple one-to-one redirects from an existing supplied URL inventory. Migration discovery, large migrations and redirect chains require separate scope.
